📊 **Market Brief — Friday, June 5, 2026**

*Snapshot:*
• S&P 500: 7,584.31 (+0.41%)
• Dow Jones: 51,561.93 (+1.73%) 🔝
• Nasdaq: 26,830.96 (-0.09%)
• VIX: 15.72 (+2.08%)

*Why the Market is Moving:*
Ceasefire optimism offsetting tech pullback. The Dow's outperformance reflects rotation into energy & value following Trump's willingness to meet Iran's leader, easing Strait of Hormuz tensions. Oil futures declined on ceasefire hopes. Tech is under pressure ahead of May jobs report—investors pulling back from growth stocks.

*Narrative:*
Markets closed mixed: strong Dow rally on ceasefire trade, S&P 500 eased higher, Nasdaq slipped into red. VIX remains low (15.72), signaling risk appetite intact but cautious ahead of macro data.

*Context:*
• May: U.S. stocks +5.26%, rally continues into June
• Tech mega-IPOs heating up (SpaceX $75B)
• Global growth concerns rise (Fitch downgrade)
• ECB rate hike expected next week
